witness.branch: Vehicle turned in front of a fire-station driveway, entrance or approaches.
witness.quote: No vehicle in front of the driveway, entrance or approaches to a fire station shall be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction.
witness.reason: The fixed intersection reversal and separate other vehicle are compatible with a fire-station frontage turning location.
required_context: Applicable LVMC jurisdiction and identified fire station.
Establish municipal jurisdiction and fire-station identity and geometry relative to the turning vehicle.
Fire-station frontage, entrance and approach geometry relative to the reversal.
Keep the frontage prohibition distinct from using the entrance or approaches for a turning purpose.
Preserve unresolved spatial meanings, vehicle-definition applicability and municipal incorporation.
Provide a usable reversal route and retain all relevant movements, footprints and travel directions.
Separate other-vehicle identity, subtype, position, trajectory and timing.
Specify the other vehicle's identity, subtype, route, position and timing without inferring priority or emergency status.
Usable reversal route without assuming that the other vehicle establishes any priority or specialized status.
witness.subject_reason: The motor vehicle operated by the selected party is the turning subject; the other vehicle remains separate.
